subject: Coord: tri-party co-sell demo — facilitator coverage & time-slice arbitration
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@cloudforge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: tri-party co-sell demo with AWS SI

Hi Jordan,

Hope you’re well — CloudForge is ready to move to a joint co-sell demo with our AWS SI (Devon Marsh) and we wanted to block a session for next week. Primary ask: 45m technical + 15m Q&A, runthrough focused on Redwood inference performance and the marketplace integration flow.

Hard constraints on our side:
- AWS SI (Devon) is only available 10am–2pm PT on weekdays (limited travel week).
- CloudForge’s engineering lead is on PST but needs a 30m prep call an hour before the demo.

Can Redwood provide a facilitator who can run the agenda, share the Marketplace workflows, and handle fallback routing? If possible we’d like two facilitator options (primary + backup) in case of last-minute conflicts.

Thanks,
Lina
Account Lead — CloudForge
Attachment: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: tri-party co-sell demo with AWS SI

Hi Lina — thanks for the details. Looping in Vanessa (partner ops) and Karthik (SI programs) so we can confirm facilitator coverage and an ops runbook.

High-level plan:
- 45m product + 15m Q&A as requested.
- 30m prep slot for CloudForge eng one hour earlier — we’ll add that to the calendar if that works.
- I’ll propose two Redwood facilitators: Vanessa (primary) and Karthik (backup) — both familiar with Marketplace flows.

Quick Qs:
1) What’s the preferred audience? (SA-only, product + procurement, or exec invite?)
2) Any platform restrictions we should know about (appliance environment, private VPC access, demonstration data rules)?

I’ll draft a proposed slots .ics and a short runbook (ops checklist + fallback plan) and share with this thread by Friday.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lina Park <lina@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: tri-party co-sell demo with AWS SI

Thanks Jordan & Lina — happy to primary facilitate. Notes from my side:
- I can own the run of show and screen-share of Marketplace flows. Karthik can cover the deeper infra/ops nuances and will be on standby to jump in.
- Availability (PT): Mon–Thu 10:00–13:00; Fri 10:00–11:30. If we need a later slot for EMEA/APAC attendees, we should consider a split session.

Operational concerns to flag:
- If we do the prep call + demo back-to-back, we should allow a 10m buffer to handle handoffs and brief tech checks.
- For fallback: if the primary facilitator is pulled into an escalation we’ll auto-failover to Karthik and promote a Redwood engineer (Maya/Sergio) as second backup — they’ll accept screen share and handle model-level questions.

I attached a short runbook and a proposed .ics with candidate slots (two PT slots per day to increase overlap with AWS SI window).

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: runbook_v3.pdf; proposed_slots.ics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lina Park <lina@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Devon Marsh <devon@aws-partners.amazonaws.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: tri-party co-sell demo with AWS SI

Quick tech note:
- For Marketplace walkthroughs where we show a Private deployment example, we need the CloudForge rep to acknowledge they’re comfortable with demo artifact retention for 48 hrs (log capture for postmortem if something odd occurs). If that’s not acceptable we’ll mask live signals and use replayed traces.

Slot arbitration I ran: given Devon’s 10–14 PT constraint and our availability, top candidate is:
- Tue Apr 3, 2028: 11:00–12:00 PT (30m prep at 10:00) — gives a 10m buffer between prep/demo.
Alternate: Wed Apr 4, 11:30–12:30 PT (prep 10:30) — slightly later but still within Devon’s window.

I’ll stand by as backup facilitator and will bring an infra lead if we dive into runtime/quantization specifics.

Karthik Iyer
SI Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@cloudforge.ai>, Devon Marsh <devon@aws-partners.amazonaws.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Tue Apr 3, 11:00 PT — tri-party demo (runbook + prep)

All — confirmed per thread:
- Demo: Tue, Apr 3, 2028, 11:00–12:00 PT.
- Prep: Tue, Apr 3, 2028, 10:00–10:30 PT (CloudForge eng prep + quick tech check).
- Facilitators: Vanessa (primary), Karthik (backup), Maya Lin (engineer backup).
- Attachments (runbook_v3.pdf / proposed_slots.ics) were shared earlier — I’ve also uploaded the runbook to the Drive link in this thread.
- Action items: Lina — please confirm CloudForge eng will join the 10:00 prep and confirm the 48-hr log capture note from Karthik. Devon — please confirm the slot works for AWS SI.

Thanks everyone — I’ll send invites and the short run-of-show doc now.

—Jordan
